title: "Day 2 – Tools and the reproduction"

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Slides.** The deck of the three days is in preparation, and the [slides page](slides.qmd) shows the deck of the earlier three-day course meanwhile.
:::

Day 2 is the day of the tools. It teaches R and the IDE on the data of the case, builds the analysis file from the raw files, and ends with a reproduction, with time to understand every line of the code that produced it. The five analysts built their data from the same raw files, each in their own way: two on country-years, one on country-wave cells and two on the respondents themselves. Each participant reproduces the value that Multi100 recorded for one of the five, from the raw waves and the code that the analyst deposited. The day runs as four sessions of ninety minutes.

## 1. R and the IDE

[Read Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Read the module on the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The first session covers objects, data frames, the pipe, and reading files and looking at them, in the IDE that you installed on day 1. The first steps in R are taught in the module of that name on the AR4DS site, and [R on the country-year panel](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) on this site takes them to the panel of the case.

## 2. From the raw files to the analysis file

[Read Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The second session is data management on the raw files. It builds the country-year panel of the paper, aggregated from the respondents of the Eurobarometer waves, with the scales of EU framing built from the items that each respondent mentioned.

## 3. The reproduction

[Read the five reanalysts in the case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-reanalysts){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Read the exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The third session sets out the five reanalyses and the choices that separate them. Each participant chooses one of the five and reproduces it in Task 3 of the workspace, reading the code line by line.

## 4. The report

[Read Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The last session writes the reproduced value up in the Quarto report of the workspace, with a short statement of what was reproduced and how, and sends it to the class. The module on Quarto is on the AR4DS site.

**By the end of the day** you can find your way around R and the IDE, you have built the analysis file of the case from the raw data, and you have reproduced one recorded result and written down how.
